h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gurgaon

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gurgaon

items.pText: Gurgaon, officially Gurugram, sends us two kinds of enquiries more than any other: corporate campuses and premium housing societies. Offices want a play corner beside the creche or for family days, and societies want a play area that matches the look of their clubhouse. FunPlay Systems designs and builds this equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,090 km away, and sends it to the NCR by road.

On sites like these, the look of the equipment counts for almost as much as its play value. Our NexLev series includes wooden play structures and larger towers, and our design team can customise colours and details to suit an architect's plan. Gurgaon's summers are very hot and dry, and its winters bring smog and cold mornings, so we talk through materials before you choose. Share your drawings or photos, and we will send a layout with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Wooden or roto-moulded equipment for a premium site

c: Wooden structures give a warm, natural look that suits a green courtyard or a clubhouse lawn. They need more care than galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic, including regular cleaning and checks on the fixings. For a creche corner, keep heights low and choose compact pieces that fit a small fenced area. On a society lawn, a single feature tower can anchor the whole play space, with smaller pieces around it for toddlers.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,090 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply play equipment for an office creche in Gurgaon?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the size of the space and the ages of the children. For a creche we suggest low, compact pieces and rubber flooring, laid out so staff can see every child from one spot.

items.q: Do wooden play structures suit Gurgaon's weather?
items.a: They can, with regular care. Dry summers and damp winter mornings are hard on wood, so plan cleaning and checks of the fixings. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic need less looking after.

items.q: Can you match our architect's colour scheme?
items.a: Yes. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and design customisation on request. Share the colour references from your architect, and we will suggest a combination for each piece.
